PC: Begins with ABC’s (must demonstrate or state that they are evaluating the airway/breathing and circulation)
Obtains sufficient history (Majority of: injury history including head injury, helmet use, +/- LOC, current complaints, medical/cardiac hx)
Place on monitors (cardiorespiratory and pulse oximetry)
Asks for IV access to be obtained
Conducts exam for other signs of trauma
Asks for 20 cc/kg IV fluid bolus
Prepares equipment (Bag/Mask, defibrillator to bedside, EKG on during cardioversion)
Gives repeated doses of adenosine (0.1, 0.2 mg/kg) until rhythm returns to sinus (any adenosine use gets credit)
SBP: Calls cardiology consult (w/o prompting and before adenosine is given)
